A '''cargo liner''' was a type of transport used by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]].

==History==
[[File:CargoLinerDaimansPersonalCarrier-KnightErrant0.jpg|thumb|left|150px|thumb|[[Daiman's personal carrier|Daiman's carrier]] with a cargo liner.]]
Several cargo liners were used to transport [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] off of [[Chelloa]] within Daiman's domain. They were attacked during a routine pick-up by a liner hijacked by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike team.
